table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	code=srledger.srinvcode,
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end, 
	users.username,  
	salecat=max(srledger.srcatcode),
	custref=max(srledger.custrefno),
	custcode=srledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.srledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=srledger.custcode),
	headerinvno=max(srledger.headerinvno),
	saleinvcode=dbo.srledger.saleinvcode,   
	serverdate=getdate(),
	Date=dbo.srledger.date,
	discperc=dbo.srledger.discperc,   
	advancetaxamt=dbo.srledger.advancetaxamt,   
	misccharges=dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
	FBRPOSFee=dbo.srledger.FBRPOSFee,   
	flatdisc=dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
	salestax=dbo.srledger.salestax,   
	dbo.srledger.custcode,   
	remarks=dbo.srledger.remarks,   
	icode=dbo.srdetail.icode,   
	gcode=max(dbo.srdetail.gcode), 
	cashreceived=0.00,
	Id        = MAX(dbo.srdetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(srdetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(srdetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(srdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(srdetail.srprice), 
	rate      = max(srdetail.srprice),
	salestax  = max(srdetail.salestax),   
	itemgstperc=MAX(srdetail.gstperc),
	SalesTaxSchedule_prec = (SELECT MAX(STS.taxperc) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	TaxType = (SELECT MAX(STS.TaxType) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	itemunitsalestax=srdetail.unitsalestax,
	discperc  = srdetail.discperc, 
	clonediscperc=srdetail.discperc,
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc = 0.00, 
	cloneitemflatdisc=0.00,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(srledger.machinename),
	totaltaxonInv=dbo.fn_gettaxonsrinv(srledger.srinvcode),
	fiscalinvoiceno = srledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
	cashtendered=max(srledger.cashtendered),
	cashcharged=max(srledger.cashcharged),
	InvTotal = max(srledger.InvTotal),
	CardCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=:ra_InvCode),0),
	PreviousLoyalty = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE 
			LC.AccCode = dbo.srledger.custcode AND 
			ISNULL(LC.InvoiceType,'') + STR(ISNULL(LC.InvoiceCode,0)) <> 'SV' + STR(dbo.srledger.saleinvcode)), 0),
	PointsAdded = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE LC.AccCode = dbo.srledger.custcode AND LC.InvoiceType = 'SV' AND LC.InvoiceCode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	TotalLoyalty = 
		ISNULL((SELECT PL=SUM(LC.PointsDebit - LC.PointsCredit) 
		FROM LoyaltyCardLedger LC 
		WHERE LC.AccCode = dbo.srledger.custcode), 0),
		reprintcounter=max(srledger.reprintingcounter)
FROM dbo.srledger,   
	dbo.srdetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) AND 
	( srledger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( srdetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	srledger.srinvcode,
	srledger.saleinvcode, 
	srledger.date, 
	srledger.custcode, 
	srledger.discperc, 
	srledger.flatdisc, 
	srledger.misccharges, 
	srledger.headerno,
	srledger.salestax, 
	srledger.remarks, 
	srledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
	dbo.srledger.advancetaxamt,   
	dbo.srledger.FBRPOSFee, 
	srdetail.icode, 
	srdetail.srprice,
	srdetail.discperc,
	srdetail.gstperc,
	srdetail.unitsalestax,
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
	users.username
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.srdetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: 'S/R #:' + ' '+string(code) + SPACE(5) + if(isnull(saleinvcode),'', 'Sale Inv #:' + ' ' + string(saleinvcode)) + SPACE(5)  + 'POS No.:' + ' '+f_StringPreferences('FBRPOSID')

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: ROUND(((Round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)) / if(looseqty > 0, looseqty, 1)),2)

objects.name: t_16
objects.visible: 1	if(sum((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all)=0,0,1)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)

objects.name: t_24
objects.visible: 1	if(SUM((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )=0,0,1)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: if(len(trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms1')))) = 0, '', trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms1'))) + '.~r~n') + if(len(trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms2')))) = 0, '', trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms2'))) + '.~r~n') + if(len(trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms3')))) = 0, '', trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms3'))) + '.~r~n')+ if(len(trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms4')))) = 0, '', trim(wordcap( f_StringPreferences('Quartterms4'))) + '.~r~n') + IF(ISNULL(f_saleinvfooter()),'',f_saleinvfooter())

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: 'Verify this invoice through FBR TaxAsaan MobileApp or SMS at 9966 and win exciting prizes in draw'

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: InvTotal /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0) +totaltaxoninv*/

objects.name: c_totaldiscval
objects.visible: 1	if(SUM((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )=0,0,1)
objects.expression: SUM((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: sum(looseqty * if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', (saledetail_rate - itemunitsalestax) , saledetail_saleprice ) for all)

objects.name: compute_24
objects.visible: 1	if((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01))=0,0,1)
objects.expression: (looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01))

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (looseqty * (saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, itemflatdisc)))  *  ( 1 -  ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01))

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: (looseqty * saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', 0, looseqty * itemflatdisc)) * (1 - ( if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01)) + round( c_amount * itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: compute_25
objects.expression: if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', (saledetail_rate - cloneitemflatdisc) * (1 - clonediscperc * 0.01) , (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail_discperc * 0.01))
